November 23, 37.

Dear Dr. Patterson,

The organization you refer to
is the "Vocational Circles Association to save
the Nation".

It was closed by the Police on
November 5 because of objectionable activities.
It was inaugurated on September 12 by members of
the National Salvation Association, the Tangpu,
Mr. Wong Siau-lai and others. Seven leaders of
the National Salvation Association were under
arrest for communistic activities for some time
prior to the outbreak of hostilities and were later
released by order of the Government. There is no
doubt that they took a leading part in the formation
of the present Association and it is probable that
they are still carrying on their activities in a
secret way. There is no reason to believe that
they have changed their views to any extent. If
you should obtain any information as to their present
activities, I would be glad to have it.

Yours sincerely,

〔此处有手写签名〕

Dr. J. Lee H. Paterson,
The Lester Chinese Hospital.

1937年11月23日。

亲爱的帕特森博士：

阁下所提及的组织是“职业界救亡协会”。

该组织因从事不良活动，已于11月5日被警方查封。该组织于9月12日由全国救国会成员、塘浦（音译）的黄小赖先生等人发起成立。在战事爆发前的一段时间里，全国救国会的七名领导人曾因共产主义活动被捕，后奉政府命令获释。毫无疑问，他们在当前协会的组建中发挥了主导作用，而且他们很可能仍在秘密开展活动。没有理由相信他们的观点有任何程度的改变。如果您能获取有关他们目前活动的任何信息，我将不胜感激。

此致

敬礼

〔此处有手写签名〕

J. Lee H. Paterson 博士，
仁济医院。

（左侧页边批注：C.(S.B) C 23/11；印章：B 1937年11月27日；手写：J.L.C. C 23/11）

November 10th 1937

Commissioner Young,
S.M. Police.

Dear Mr. Young,

I wonder if I may again take advantage of your
kindness to have an enquiry placed in the right quarter.

We have had some of our trained nurses leaving the
hospital recently, without notice, and there are others who are some-
what unsettled. There is a strong probability that this is due to
influences from a group calling themselves the 'Professionals' National
Salvation Society', or some such name. I enclose the Chinese name
with this.

I understand that a number of such societies have
recently been closed down by the Police of the Settlement and Concession,
partly because of communistic tendencies. They are apt to get hold of
these young inexperienced persons. I should be glad to know if this
is one of these societies. I am anxious not to have open enquiries
amongst the nurses lest it precipitate any crisis. Any information
along these lines would be most valuable.

Yours most sincerely,

J Lee A Fulinson

1937年11月10日

杨专员，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

亲爱的杨先生：

不知我能否再次劳驾阁下，向有关部门进行查询。

最近，我院一些受过培训的护士未提前通知便离职，另有一些护士情绪颇为不稳。这很有可能是受到一个自称为“职业界救国会”或类似名称的团体的影响所致。随函附上该组织的中文名称。

据悉，此类社团近期已被租界和法租界的警方取缔，部分原因是其具有共产主义倾向。这些团体往往容易控制这些年轻且缺乏经验的人员。我很想知道这是否属于此类社团之一。我不希望在护士中进行公开查询，以免引发危机。任何沿此方向的信息都将极具价值。

此致

最诚挚的问候，

J Lee A Fulinson

Date November 6, 19 37

Subject Closure of the Shanghai Vocational Circles Association to Save
the Nation, Lane 132, House 4, Park Road.
Made by D. J. Darby Forwarded by C Gaudart

Between 11.30 a.m. and 12.15 p.m. November 5, detectives
attached to the Special Branch with the assistance of the
detective staff of Sinza Station, proceeded to Lane 132, House 4,
Park Road, where the offices of the Shanghai Vocational
Circles Association to Save the Nation (上海市職業界救亡協會)
are located, and seized and brought to Headquarters a quantity
of pamphlets, magazines, receipt books, correspondence etc.,
connected with the Association.

Mr. Tang Sao-tsing (唐少珍), a staff member of the
Consolation Section of the Vocational Circles Association to
Save the Nation, who was present during the visit of the
Police, was informed that this organization by order of the
Shanghai Municipal Council would not be permitted to function
in the International Settlement. However, should the
association desire to make an application to the Shanghai
Municipal Council for registration, such application should be
submitted to Police Headquarters for consideration.

Arrangements were made by Sinza Station for the posting of
a C.P.C. on the premises in order to ensure that the instructions
of the Police were obeyed.

事由：查封位于派克路（Park Road）132弄4号的上海职业界救亡协会。
呈报人：D. J. Darby 转呈人：C Gaudart

11月5日上午11时30分至中午12时15分之间，特别巡捕房的侦探在新闸路警站侦探股的协助下，前往派克路132弄4号，即上海职业界救亡协会（上海市職業界救亡協會）办事处所在地，查获并带回总部大量与该协会有关的宣传册、杂志、收据簿、信件等物品。

当时在场的职业界救亡协会慰问组工作人员唐少珍先生被告知，根据上海公共租界工部局的命令，该组织不得在国际租界内活动。但是，如果该协会希望向上海公共租界工部局申请注册，应将申请提交至警务处总部审议。

新闸路警站已安排在该处派驻一名中国警员（C.P.C.），以确保警方指令得到遵守。

随函附上在上述办事处查获的文件清单。

随后，在11月6日上午11时25分，特别巡捕房成员访问了位于重庆路270弄的新群职业学校，会见了该校校长兼派克路132弄4号房屋的第一承租人张新伯先生，并告知他上海职业界救亡协会必须将其活动限制在救济难民

It was learned from Mr. Chang that he had sub-let three rooms at Lane 132, House 4, Park Road, to a friend of his, one Yoen Tsing-wei ( 袁清章 ), a certain Mr. Pan Niang-yao acting as gurantor. In accordance with the instructions of the Police, Mr. Chang promised to inform the second tenant, Yuen Tsing-wei, through the guarantor, Mr. Pan, of the Police warning. He also stated that should the Municipal Council at any future time consider the occupation of his premises by the Vocational Circles Association to be undesirable, he would be pleased to ask the second tenant to remove. Although he would do his best to see that the instructions of the Police were adhered to, Mr. Chang stated that he would not be responsible for the activities of the Association as he himself took no part in them. However, should the necessity arise, he would be willing to take steps to see that the guarantor shouldered all responsibility.

It is of interest to note here that Mr. Pan, the so-called guarantor, is a leading figure in the Vocational Circles Association, though he himself has avoided acting as second tenant of the premises. Yoen Tsing-wei, the sub-lessee, is the secretary of the Association and it will be recalled that this individual was arrested by the Municipal Police on March 15, 1936, for being concerned in the strike of workers of the Yue Fong Cotton Mill, 2866 Yangtzeroo Road. At that time, Yoen was a member of the now defunct Business Circles National Salvation Association. His home at 355 , North Kiangse Road was raided and quantities of communistic and anti-government literature were seized by the Municipal Police. Though

据张先生称，他将派克路132弄4号的三个房间转租给了他的朋友袁清章，由潘良耀先生担任担保人。按照警方的指示，张先生承诺通过担保人潘先生将警方的警告转达给第二承租人袁清章。他还表示，如果工部局将来认为职业界救亡协会占用其房屋不妥，他很乐意要求第二承租人搬离。虽然他会尽力确保遵守警方的指示，但张先生表示，由于他本人并未参与该协会的活动，因此不对该协会的活动负责。不过，如有必要，他愿意采取措施，确保担保人承担全部责任。

值得注意的是，所谓的担保人潘先生是职业界救亡协会的核心人物，尽管他本人避免担任该房屋的第二承租人。第二承租人袁清章是该协会的秘书。值得一提的是，此人曾于1936年3月15日因涉及杨树浦路2866号悦丰纱厂工人罢工案被工部局警务处逮捕。当时，袁是现已解散的商界救国会的成员。他在江西路北路355号的住所遭到搜查，工部局警务处查获了大量共产主义及反政府文献。尽管

File No. ____
S.I. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date September 10 37.

Subject Shanghai vocational circles Association to Save the Nation -
inaugurated.

Made by C.D.I. Sin Tse-Wang Forwarded by C Crawford S.S.

（批：I have seen the representatives that place the Shanghai vocational Circles Association to Save the Nation (職業界救亡協會) was formally inaugurated at a meeting held at 3.30 p.m. September 10 at the Sin Kwen Vocational School, 270 Chungking Road, when about 230 persons attended including Mr. So Chien-li (沙千里), one of the seven national salvationists recently released from Soochow. Speeches advising those present to be united in dealing with the national crisis were delivered by Mr. Wong Shiao-lai, Chairman of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce, and others. Fifty four persons, including Mr. So Chien Li, Mr. Chow Lao-chi (周肇基), one of the promoters of the now defunct Shanghai Amateur Travelling Group, Mr. Wong Mei-yun (汪曼雲), a staff member of the local Tan-pu, Mr. Pan Shu-lan (潘序倫), a chartered accountant, were appointed to the executive committee.）

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER 17 SEP. 1937）

During the meeting, it was decided that the following resolutions be referred to and discussed at a meeting of the executive committee:-

1) That education on national defence be enforced among refugees.
2) That no products of the enemy be bought, sold or transported.
3) That measures for the punishment of traitorous merchants be devised.
4) That control of foreign exchange be adopted.
5) That unemployed youths be organized to carry out propaganda work in the interior.
6) That the National Government be requested to sever diplomatic relations with Japan.
7) That the National Government be requested to confiscate the property of Japanese residents in China.

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER (SMP) 16 SEP. 1937）

（批：DC (C & SB) Political matters of this kind outside Settlement mg. Can you take appropriate action?）

（印：18 SEPT. 1937）

日期 1937年9月10日。

主题 上海职业界救亡协会 - 成立。

呈报人 侦探员 辛泽旺 (Sin Tse-Wang) 转呈人 C Crawford S.S.

（批：我已获悉，上海职业界救亡协会（職業界救亡協會）于9月10日下午3时30分在重庆路270号新群职业学校举行的会议上正式成立，约有230人出席，其中包括最近从苏州获释的七君子之一沙千里 (So Chien-li) 先生。华人商会主席黄晓籁 (Wong Shiao-lai，音译) 先生及其他人士发表演讲，劝勉在场人士团结应对国家危机。五十四人当选为执行委员会委员，包括沙千里 (So Chien Li) 先生、已解散的上海业余旅行团发起人之一周肇基 (Chow Lao-chi) 先生、当地党部工作人员汪曼雲 (Wong Mei-yun) 先生、会计师潘序倫 (Pan Shu-lan) 先生等。）

（印：副总监 1937年9月17日）

会议期间，决定将以下决议提交执行委员会会议审议和讨论：-

1) 在难民中加强国防教育。
2) 不购买、销售或运输敌货。
3) 制定惩处奸商的措施。
4) 实行外汇管制。
5) 组织失业青年在内地开展宣传工作。
6) 请求国民政府与日本断绝外交关系。
7) 请求国民政府没收在华日本居民的财产。

（印：副总监 (SMP) 1937年9月16日）

（批：DC (C & SB) 此类政治事务超出租界管辖范围。你能采取适当行动吗？）

（印：1937年9月18日）

A new organization entitled the "Shanghai Vocational
Circles Association to Save the Nation" (上海市職業界救亡協會)
came into existence on August 28, 1937, with a preparatory
office in the Sing Kwai Vocational School, Lane 270, 3
Caungking Road. Its object is to unite the people connected
with vocational circles to render assistance to the Govern-
ment in its task of resisting invasion. This organization,
according to the regulations, is under the control of the
Shanghai Municipality Various Circles Committee to Support
Resistance against the Enemy, 480 Yu Ya Ching Road.

The following are the promoters :-

Mr. Wang Mei-yuin (汪曼雲), lawyer and committee
member of the local Kuomintang.

Joint Savings Society of Yen Yieh,
Kincheng, Continental and China & South
Sea Banks.

Joint Savings Society of Yen Yieh, Kincheng,
Continental and China & South Sea Banks.

of local vocational and amateur bodies in their movement,

一个名为“上海职业界救亡协会”（上海市職業界救亡協會）的新组织于1937年8月28日成立，筹备处设在重庆路3号270弄新群职业学校。其宗旨是团结职业界人士，协助政府完成抵抗侵略的任务。根据章程，该组织受位于虞洽卿路480号的上海各界抗敌后援会管辖。

发起人为：-

汪曼雲 (Wang Mei-yuin) 先生，律师，当地国民党委员。

潘仰堯 (Pan Hyang-yao) 先生，盐业、金城、大陆及中南银行联合准备库职员。

李文杰 (Li Vung-chieh) 先生，注册会计师。

沙千里 (Soo Chien-li) 先生，律师，当地救国会七大领袖之一，最近从鲍威尔 (Bowbow，原文如此，疑指苏州监狱或相关地点) 获释。

袁清偉 (Yuen Tsing-wei) 先生，南市杜金路 (Doh Chin Road，音译) 元松工业社。

王文青 (Wong Vung-tsing) 先生，海关职员俱乐部会员。

黃逸峰 (Hwang Yih-foong) 先生，盐业、金城、大陆及中南银行联合准备库职员。
